concept.concept: Cartoon loaf of sourdough with a grumpy face and the text 'I Waited 72 Hours for This' in a retro stamp style
concept.audience: Home bakers obsessed with long-ferment sourdough who enjoy self-deprecating humor
concept.rationale: Sourdough culture remains a dedicated evergreen niche with passionate buyers; humor targeting the waiting process is relatable and lightly saturated at the quirky-humor angle

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "I WAITED 72 HOURS FOR THIS" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a round sourdough loaf with a grumpy, scowling face (two angry eyes and a frown mouth), centered on plain cream background. Bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, screen-print aesthetic. Color palette: warm golden-brown for loaf, charcoal gray for facial features, burnt orange for accent score marks. Solid color blocks, no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Above the loaf in a circular retro postal stamp border (dashed circle outline in charcoal gray with small corner tick marks), the text 'I WAITED 72 HOURS FOR THIS' in bold condensed sans-serif capitals. Design is single centered composition with generous margins, readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.style: Bold retro stamp style — circular dashed border with postal tick marks, text in all capitals, condensed sans-serif, arched within the stamp frame

verdict.reason: The design features a generic cartoon sourdough loaf with a grumpy face, which is a common humorous illustration style with no connection to specific protected characters or brands. The phrase 'I Waited 72 Hours for This' is an original, descriptive phrase referencing the well-known 72-hour sourdough fermentation process. It does not reference any known trademark, slogan, brand, celebrity, or protected intellectual property. Retro stamp styling is a generic design aesthetic. This concept appears safe for print-on-demand use.

image_verdict.reason: Text reads exactly 'I WAITED 72 HOURS FOR THIS' with correct spelling and complete wording. The design features a clean, original cartoon anthropomorphized sourdough bread loaf with an angry expression, a generic comic illustration style with no IP concerns. Text is bold, legible, and well-rendered. Background is simple and suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: I Waited 72 Hours for This Sourdough Tee | Grumpy Loaf
listing.description: Cartoon sourdough loaf with grumpy expression and retro stamp-style text: 'I Waited 72 Hours for This.' Celebrate the patience obsession of long-ferment bakers who treat timing like science and humor like survival strategy. Perfect for home bakers who embrace fermentation culture and self-deprecating jokes about their bread-making dedication. Soft cotton for bakers who earn their irony.
